messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-call alignment: streaming + function-calls — SDK integration and next steps

Hi Cameron / Maya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick post-call summary to make sure we’re aligned and to capture the immediate next steps. Please review and flag anything I missed.

Summary of pain and goals (as I heard them)
- Latency: current user-perceived generation latency ~250–350ms for short completions; target is <200ms end-to-end for core flows.
- Throughput: spikes up to ~1k req/s during peak batch imports.
- Quality: cascade of reranking for search & suggestions using embeddings + reranker -> must preserve precision at top-3.
- Functionality: streaming generation (partial tokens) is required for UX; structured outputs (JSON) from function-calls are preferred to reduce client parsing work.
- Compliance: retention controls and audit logs matter; SOC2 evidence will be needed for procurement.

Redwood product fit (high level)
- Streaming: our SDK can deliver websocket-based streaming plus chunked REST streaming; we can demo both. Continuous batching and KV cache will help hit latency SLOs for repeated contexts.
- Function calling / structured outputs: recommend using function-call schema + output validation to return typed JSON that maps to your downstream services.
- Embeddings + rerank: we suggest a hybrid approach — generate candidate embeddings with worker pool, index in your vector DB, and use Redwood rerank API to re-score top candidates for accuracy.
- Deployment mode: start with Hosted API (fastest time-to-value) and consider Dedicated capacity if you want predictable throughput / private pools.

Technical assumptions / constraints we discussed
- Typical prompt lengths: 250–600 tokens; some long contexts up to 2k tokens for historical context pulls.
- SLO target: 95th-percentile <200ms for the small-short completions path (we should instrument to split cold vs warm kv-cache).
- Model candidates: open Llama-family variants for cost-effective POC; we can mirror to higher-capacity variants for production.

Proposed next steps (owner / ETA)
1) Tech deep-dive (Ben / Karthik) — 60–90 min: streaming demo + function-calling sample (owner: Karthik). Proposed slots Wed 2026-09-16 16:00–17:30 UTC or Thu morning.
2) Pricing and pilot SOW — ballpark token cost and 4-week POC scope (owner: Ben). Deliver by EOD Fri 2026-09-18.
3) Security/compliance intake — I’ll send SOC2 and retention details; you also mentioned a filled questionnaire (please attach).
4) Sample dataset and test plan — Integron to send 1–2 representative prompt sets (Maya).

Attachments: architecture-sketch.png (very rough, shows streaming vs polling flow we discussed).

If that all looks right, I’ll schedule the deep-dive and loop in engineering.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

---
Note: we’ll also prepare a short demo repo that shows: 1) SDK streaming websocket example, 2) function-call -> validated JSON flow, 3) embeddings -> rerank sample.
